Description: Every row, column, and 3×3 box must contain the digits 1 to 9 exactly once.

Digits separated by a white dot must be consecutive.
Digits separated by a black dot are such that one is double the other.
Digits along a thermometer increase from the bulb to the tip.
Cells in the same relative position in their 3x3 box must not contain the same digit.
Adjacent digits along a green line must differ by at least 5.
Orthogonally adjacent cells may not contain consecutive digits.
The digits on a purple line must contain a non-repeating set of consecutive digits in any order
Digits along a slow thermometer must either stay the same or increase from the bulb to the tip.
Adjacent digits along an orange line must differ by at least 4.
Digits inside a circle appear in one of the four surrounding cells.
Fixed Thermometer: Digits along the thermometers strictly increase from the bulb to the tip by a fixed step.
The same digit cannot appear one cell diagonally adjacent from itself.
The digits along the shaft of an arrow must sum to the digit at the circle.
Cells with arrows pointing outward must contain digits greater than all orthogonal cells.
Cells with arrows pointing inward must contain digits less than all orthogonal cells.
Digits appear along a gray line in the same order when read forward or backwards.
V between two cells indicates that the cells sum to 5
X between two cells indicates that the cells sum to 10.

Min binary tree: each parent node is smaller than its children.
Max binary tree: each parent node is larger than its children.
The digit on the open side of the ">" sign must be larger than the digit on the pointed side.
The same digit cannot appear twice within a knight's move (2 over and 1 across in any direction)
The digits in each cage must sum up to the number in the top left corner of the cage. Digits cannot repeat inside a cage.
Cells containing a square must be even
Cells containing a circle must be odd.
